caption: The drawing features a single ornate object, shaped like a lidded vessel or urn, positioned vertically in the center of the page. The object is rendered in black and white pencil or ink on a beige background. The vessel has a broad, rounded body that tapers towards the foot and neck. The pedestal base is circular and flares slightly outward. The lower and upper sections of the body are decorated with intricate floral and scrollwork engravings, and the upper portion features a monogram or stylized inscription within a decorative cartouche. The lid is tall and dome-shaped with vertical segments, each punctuated by a series of small dots or holes, and topped with a finial shaped like a pointed knob. In the upper right corner of the page, there is a smaller line drawing of the same object shown in profile with dimensions marked (6 3/4 inches tall and 2 7/8 inches wide). The name "HANS WESTENDORF" is inscribed in block letters near the bottom left margin, within the border of the drawing.
title: Silver Caster
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
